change.title: pr-5
change.description: adding flexbox to header via mixins (all prefixes)
change.author: awesomerobot

findings.title: Small-action buttons no longer sit at the right edge of the row
findings.body: `.small-action` is now a flex row (topic-post.scss:263-265), and `.small-action-desc` (line 279) is a flex item with no `flex-grow`, so its width is its content width instead of the full row width it had as a block. The delete/edit buttons are children of `.small-action-desc` (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/components/small-action.hbs:3-9), and they keep `float: right` from the `.small-action button` rule (topic-post.scss:306-310). Those floats now end at the right edge of the description text, not the right edge of the row, so for short descriptions the buttons move up against the text. The PR body does not mention this. Suggested fix: give `.small-action-desc` `flex: 1` (or `flex-grow: 1`) so it fills the row again. No other rule in desktop/ or mobile/ sets a width or flex on `.small-action-desc` (mobile/topic-post.scss:516-523 only sets padding and margin).
findings.originReason: This diff adds the flexbox display on `.small-action`. Before it, `.small-action-desc` was a block that filled the full row width.

verification.reason: `.small-action` is now a flex container (lines 264-265), so `.small-action-desc` becomes a flex item with no flex-grow and no width, and it sizes to its content. The delete/edit buttons sit inside it (small-action.hbs:3-9) and float right (lines 306-310), so with a short description they end up next to the text instead of at the row's right edge. No desktop or mobile rule gives `.small-action-desc` a width or flex.

findings.title: `-ms-align-items` is not a real property
findings.body: The `align-items` mixin emits `-ms-align-items`, which no browser implements. The IE10 spelling is `-ms-flex-align`, and that line is already present on line 120. Removing line 121 changes no rendering.
findings.originReason: This diff adds the whole align-items mixin.

verification.reason: `-ms-align-items` is not a property any browser implements. IE10's prefixed form is `-ms-flex-align`, which line 120 already emits, so removing line 121 changes nothing.

findings.title: Removed bullet margin-top in the header extra info: intended?
findings.body: The rule `.extra-info-wrapper .badge-wrapper.bullet { margin-top: 5px; }` is removed (the old block at topic.scss:33-35). The extra-info wrapper is now a flex item centered by `.contents { align-items: center }` (header.scss:14-18, header.hbs:93-95), so the bullet badge's vertical position changes with no replacement offset. The PR body does not say whether this was tuned by eye. Confirm the bullet is still aligned with the title in the docked header.
findings.originReason: This diff removes the bullet's margin-top rule.

verification.reason: The diff removes `.extra-info-wrapper .badge-wrapper.bullet { margin-top: 5px }` and adds no replacement offset, while the header `.contents` is a flex row centered with align-items (header.scss:17-18). So the bullet's vertical position does change, and asking whether that was intended is a fair question.

contracts.action: Header is laid out as a flex row: logo (.title), .extra-info-wrapper, .panel
contracts.equivalent_path: app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/header.hbs:2-96 (the .contents children are the home-logo component, .panel and header-extra-info)
contracts.before_after: Before: .title floated left and .panel floated right inside .contents. After: .contents is display:flex with align-items:center, .extra-info-wrapper order 2 (topic.scss:30), .panel order 3 with margin-left:auto (header.scss:35-40).
contracts.visible_effect: Logo, topic title and login/icons panel sit on one row, with the panel pinned to the right. Verified that every element named in the change is a direct child of .contents, so the flex rules apply.
contracts.failure_mode: No failure path: CSS only. If the flex rules did not apply, the panel would fall back to its block position.

contracts.action: Small-action row is a flex row of avatar and description
contracts.equivalent_path: app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/components/small-action.hbs:1-18 (topic-avatar and small-action-desc are direct children of the .small-action component element)
contracts.before_after: Before: block layout, avatar floated left with desc padding-left 4em. After: flex row with align-items:center, desc padding 0 1.5%, buttons still floated.
contracts.visible_effect: Avatar and description sit side by side and are vertically centered. Buttons inside the description no longer reach the right edge of the row for short text (see the finding at topic-post.scss:279).

contracts.action: Bullet category badge switched from inline-flex and baseline to mixins
contracts.before_after: Before: display:inline-flex; align-items:baseline. After: the same two declarations emitted with vendor prefixes, ending with the unprefixed declarations.
contracts.visible_effect: None intended. The final unprefixed declarations match the old rules.
contracts.failure_mode: The mixins come from common.scss:6, which imports foundation/mixins before common/components/* (line 8), so the include resolves at compile time.

summary: Reviewed the five stylesheet files in this part. CSS only, no tests or docs touched, and no docs/adr directory exists, so there are no ADR constraints. The header flex conversion holds up: every element it targets is a direct child of .contents in header.hbs. The main defect is that .small-action-desc is now a non-growing flex item, so the delete/edit buttons float against the text instead of the row edge. The mixin file also has a non-existent -ms-align-items declaration. One visual change, the removed bullet margin-top in the header extra info, is raised as a question. The compile-time mixin import order checks out (common.scss:6 before :8). Nothing was built or run.
